summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # ** Petition No.185/MP/2017 ** **Coram:** **Shri Gireesh B. Pradhan, Chairperson Shri A.K. Singhal, Member Shri A.S. Bakshi, Member Dr. M.K. Iyer, Member** **Date of Order: 15** **th** **of November, 2017** # **In the matter of** Petition under Section 79(1) (c) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulations 8 and 26 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Open Access in inter-State Transmission) Regulations, 2008. # **And In the matter of** Ugar Sugar Works Limited- Unit 2, Mahaveernagar, Sangli Maharashtra- 416416 ** ..Petitioner** Vs. 1. Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation Ltd. Kaveri Bhawan, Bangalore Karnataka- 560009 2. Karnataka State Load Despatch Centre 28, Race Course Road, Bangalore Karnataka- 560009 # 3. Hubli Electricity Supply Company Ltd. (HESCOM) - Navanagar, Hubli, Karnataka – 580029 4. Indian Energy Exchange Unit 3,4,5 and 6, Fourth Floor, Plot No.7, TDI Centre, District Centre, Jasola, New Delhi- 110025 ** .Respondents** ___________________________________________________________________________________ Order in Petition No.185/MP/2017 Page **1** of **2** Page **1** of **2** # ** ORDER ** The Petitioner, Ugar Sugar Works Limited, has filed the present Petition _inter alia_ for seeking directions to the SLDC, Karnataka to consider its Open Access applications in accordance with Regulations 8 and 26 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Open Access in inter-State Transmission) Regulations, 2008 as amended from time to time. 2. Learned counsel for the Petitioner vide its letter dated 10.11.2017 has sought permission to withdraw the present Petition and has requested to adjust the filing fee of Rs. Three lakh against the filing fee of future Petition if filed by the Petitioner. 3. Considering the prayer of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the present Petition is disposed of as withdrawn. The filing fee paid in the present Petition shall be adjusted against the filing fee of Petition, if filed by the Petitioner in future, within a period of one year from the date of this order. 4. Accordingly, Petition No. 185/MP/2017 is disposed of with the above. ** Sd/Sd/Sd/Sd/- (Dr. M.K. Iyer) (A.S. Bakshi) (A.K. Singhal) (Gireesh B.
